decisions.story_title: Public PoC released for Cisco Expressway CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8, unauthenticated root RCE)
decisions.reason: Real vulnerability development: working exploit code for a critical unauthenticated root RCE in Cisco Expressway; Cisco advisory published 2026-10-21, patch now has public weaponization.

CVE-2026-76466.evidence: Public proof-of-concept exploit code published; no in-the-wild exploitation reported in the event.
